Name: Oriental Garden Furniture
Author: rlatmdtntmdtn
Description:
[center][/center]

[center][size=6][b][color=#4f7f73]Oriental Garden Furniture[/color][/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#8a8072]동양풍 정원 가구[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=3]169 East Asian garden furniture pieces: [b]20 wall-high windows[/b] whose views change with the seasons, day and night, rain and snow; [b]lamps you switch on and off with a click[/b]; and moving pieces such as a [b]water wheel[/b] and a [b]goldfish pond[/b].[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4][i][b]This mod was made with the help of AI,[/b][/i][/size][/color]
[color=#ffff00][size=4][i][b]with some manual retouching.[/b][/i][/size][/color]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#4f7f73]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] 4.0 or later[/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b] 2.9 or later[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#4f7f73]Installation[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Unzip and drop the whole [b]"[CP] 동양풍 정원 가구 묶음"[/b] folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].[/*]
[*]Keep both folders inside it (furniture pack and helper) together.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#4f7f73]How to get it[/color][/b][/size]
Robin sells the [b]Oriental Garden Furniture Catalogue[/b] for [b][color=#a8473a]50,000g[/color][/b].
Place it and click it to take any piece for free. It also shows in Happy Home Designer.

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#4f7f73]What's inside[/color][/b][/size] [size=3][color=#8a8072]169 pieces[/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Lighting (20)[/b] [color=#8a8072]stone lanterns, paper lamps, silk lanterns, lotus lanterns, street lamps, wall sconces[/color][/*]
[*][b]Storage (10)[/b] [color=#8a8072]display shelves, chests, a round curio shelf, a study bookcase[/color][/*]
[*][b]Plants & Garden (32)[/b] [color=#8a8072]bonsai, maple trees, bamboo planters, garden stones, ponds, a water wheel[/color][/*]
[*][b]Wall Decor (32)[/b] [color=#8a8072]hanging scrolls, framed paintings, name boards, tiled eaves[/color][/*]
[*][b]Partitions, Tables & Props (38)[/b] [color=#8a8072]folding screens, street food stalls, tea tables, tabletop props[/color][/*]
[*][b]Rugs (17)[/b] [color=#8a8072]woven mats, tatami, tile rugs, floor cushions[/color][/*]
[*][b]Windows (20)[/b] [color=#8a8072]garden picture windows, paper lattice windows, moon windows, forest, bamboo grove and pond windows[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#4f7f73]Windows[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]They fill the [b]whole wall height[/b].[/*]
[*]Views change with the [b]season[/b], [b]time of day[/b] and [b]weather[/b].[/*]
[*]Rain, snow, night lights, fireflies and pond glints are [b]animated[/b].[/*]
[*]Wide windows let light in on every tile.[/*]
[*]Frame tone (light wood / dark rosewood) and a bamboo blind can be changed in the config.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#4f7f73]Lamps[/color][/b][/size]
They light up after dark on their own, and you can [b]switch them on or off any time with a click[/b].

[line]

[size=5][b][color=#4f7f73]Options[/color][/b][/size] [size=3][color=#8a8072]helper config.json, created on first launch[/color][/size]
[list]
[*][b]WindowGlowStrength[/b] [color=#8a8072](default 0.6)[/color] daylight beam strength of this pack's windows (0 = none, 1 = vanilla)[/*]
[*][b]WindowAnimations[/b] [color=#8a8072](default on)[/color] window animations[/*]
[*][b]RainyDayWindowPicture[/b] [color=#8a8072](default on)[/color] keep the daytime picture on rainy days[/*]
[*][b]ToggleAllLamps[/b] [color=#8a8072](default off)[/color] let other mods' lamps toggle with a click too[/*]
[*][b]AllWindowsGlowPerTile[/b] [color=#8a8072](default off)[/color] per-tile light for other mods' wide windows[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#4f7f73]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6[/b] or later[/*]
[*]In multiplayer, [b]every player[/b] needs it installed.[/*]
[*]Works alongside other furniture and window mods.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b][color=#4f7f73]Credits[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI and Content Patcher by Pathoschild[/*]
[/list]
